Constraint / invariant: Unique external principal within identity provider; roles do not confer care access.
Mission type and phase are explicit. Public demo only permits simulation.

Record grain: One research cohort or simulation namespace
Constraint / invariant: Unique namespace name/type. Cross-namespace joins require separately approved linkage.

Record grain: One pseudonymous subject inside a namespace
Constraint / invariant: Unique(namespace_id, external_ref); no real names or demographics required for fictional seeds.
End must follow start. A CMO role is not a physician credential.
Only explicitly activated reviewed policy may grant access. Revoke with a new release.
Recheck at read, mutation and packet release. Deny by default.
Unique(sha256, source_uri, source_version); matching bytes do not establish licensing.
Activation requires reviewer and applicability. Demo-only releases cannot become clinical approvals.

Record grain: One source section inside a release
Constraint / invariant: Unique(release_id, source_asset_id, locator). Retain exact source locator and extraction hash.
Unique(code, version). Distinguish VO2 from VO2max and interbeat interval from breathing rate.
Unique(adapter_version, source_schema, raw_field, raw_unit). Unknown mappings quarantine.

Record grain: One producer session and clock-reset segment
Constraint / invariant: Unique(device_ref, session_ref, segment). A reboot starts a new segment.

Record grain: One original time expression and optional mapping
Constraint / invariant: Keep event time, receive time and replay time separate. Never invent UTC for L-/R+ dates.
Unique(producer_ref, namespace_id, idempotency_key). Same key/different hash is a conflict.

Record grain: One row/packet accounted for in a batch
Constraint / invariant: Unique(batch_id, source_record_key). Each record has exactly one terminal outcome.
Register ready only after atomic publication and hash check. No uploaded path traversal.
Unique(namespace_id, producer_ref, source_record_key). Current pointer update and audit are atomic.

Record grain: One immutable revision of one observation
Constraint / invariant: Unique(observation_id, revision_no). Exactly one value branch; context and subject namespace must agree.

Record grain: One explicit defect attached to a revision
Constraint / invariant: A collection defect must not be labeled as physiological deterioration.

Record grain: One reviewed baseline link for a target context
Constraint / invariant: Baseline and current belong to same subject and compatible quantity/method; never nearest-row guessing.
Evidence and engineering algorithm stay separate. Unreviewed clinical content cannot activate clinically.

Record grain: One evaluation of an exact dependency set
Constraint / invariant: No stale inputs. Dependency hash includes revisions, baseline, rule, mapping and evidence release.

Record grain: One exact input revision used by a derivation
Constraint / invariant: Unique(run_id, input_role, revision_id); no mutable current pointers in historical derivations.

Record grain: One interpretable result or applicability failure
Constraint / invariant: Separate comparison status from care priority. No global health score.
Unique active deduplication key. Version check on every transition.

Record grain: One finding linked to an episode
Constraint / invariant: Unique(episode_id, finding_id); never silently replace historical links.
AI cannot authorize or perform a care action. Allowed MVP action is request/record review.
Must have a due time OR named trigger and a responsible actor; packet receipt does not close it.
Draft preview is not permission to release; exact payload rechecked at release.
Release, audit and transfer intent commit together. Superseding a packet does not erase delivery.

Record grain: One exact revision included in a packet
Constraint / invariant: Unique(packet_id, revision_id); dependency invalidation can locate every affected packet.

Record grain: One durable send attempt for a released packet
Constraint / invariant: Unique(packet_id, attempt_no). At-least-once with receiver deduplication by packet ID/hash.
Unique(recipient_ref, packet_id, payload_hash). Receipt cannot imply medical review.

Record grain: One human review of an exact packet
Constraint / invariant: Independent from transport receipt; wrong packet/hash/relationship denied.
Unique(actor_id, scope, idempotency_key). Write receipt and domain mutation in the same transaction.
Unique(kind, dependency_hash). Commit only with current lease and current dependencies.

Record grain: One append-only decision or mutation record
Constraint / invariant: No delete/update in normal service role. Minimize medical content; hash chain is not tamper-proof storage.
Structured facts are authoritative. Late, altered or uncited outputs are discarded.
Use only for lab observations. Do not fabricate specimen context for exercise or waveform data.
Unique(object_id, channel_index). Preserve calibration and irregular timing.

Record grain: One activity or environmental context interval
Constraint / invariant: Context association requires overlapping time/location; correlation is not causation.
